item.title: What “This Is Where I Leave You” Gets Right About Grief
item.description: "This Is Where I Leave You" doesn’t treat grief as sacred or cinematic, it treats it as awkward, continuous, and quietly demanding. Rewatching it after experiencing loss, I realized the film doesn’t show grief as collapse, but as something you carry while life keeps moving. And that honesty makes all the difference. <p>The post What “This Is Where I Leave You” Gets Right About Grief first appeared on Her Campus.</p>

item.title: THE CASE AGAINST ANTI-INTELLECTUALISM
item.description: What does, “media I consumed this week” even mean? I wouldn’t conflate watching a singular video diary of a girl wearing skinny glasses and a slick-back on YouTube while she talks about her “weekly reset routine” and the intentional absorption of media. I’ve read half of the books BookTok has recommended, and let’s just say I’ve read Dramione fanfiction on Ao3 better articulated than some of these romance novels. <p>The post THE CASE AGAINST ANTI-INTELLECTUALISM first appeared on Her Campus.</p>
